messages.沈潜と破裂を付与し、ダメージを受けなかったターンの次にS2・S3を強化する人格。: An Identity that inflicts Sinking and Rupture, enhancing S2 and S3 on the turn after taking no damage.
messages.沈潜と破裂: S1「縦斬り」で沈潜、S2「二連撃」で沈潜と破裂、S3「旋風」のⅡ: **Sinking and Rupture**: S1 Downward Cleave inflicts Sinking, S2 Dual Strike inflicts Sinking and Rupture, and Coin Ⅱ of S3 Whirlwind inflicts Sinking and Rupture (plus 2 Attack Power Down on Heads Hit).
messages.ダメージを受けなかった次のターンに強化: 前のターンにダメージを受けていなければ: **Bonuses on the turn after taking no damage**: If he took no damage on the previous turn, S2 gains +1 Coin Power and S3 gains +2 Coin Power.
messages.バトルパッシブ「遊戯」(怠惰×2・共鳴): 次のターン開始時に精神力を6回復。: **Combat passive — Entertainment (2 Sloth Resonance)**: Restores 6 SP at the start of the next turn.
messages.S1・S2で沈潜と破裂を入れる。前のターンにダメージを受けていなければS2・S3: Inflict Sinking and Rupture with S1 and S2. If he took no damage on the previous turn, S2 and S3 become stronger, so prioritize S3 if it is in hand that turn.
